column2: Don't Hoard groceries and essentials. Please ensure that people who are in need don't face a shortage because of you!
column3: Be compassionate! Help those in need like the elderly and poor. They are facing a crisis you cannot even imagine!
column4: Be considerate : While buying essentials remember : You need to share with 130 Crore Others!
column5: Going out to buy essentials? Social Distancing is KEY! Maintain 2 metres distance between each other in the line.
column6: Plan ahead! Take a minute and check how much you have at home. Planning ahead let's you buy exactly what you need!
column7: Plan and calculate your essential needs for the next three weeks and get only what is bare minimum needed.
column8: Help out the elderly by bringing them their groceries and other essentials.
column9: Help out your workers and domestic workers by not cutting their salaries. Show the true Indian spirit!
column10: Lockdown means LOCKDOWN! Avoid going out unless absolutely necessary. Stay safe!
column12: Do not panic! ❌ Your essential needs will be taken care of. DO NOT HOARD.
column13: Be a true Indian. Show compassion. Be considerate. Help those in need. We will get through this!
column14: If you have symptoms and suspect you have coronavirus - reach out to your doctor or call state helplines. 📞  Get help.
column15: Stand Against FAKE News and WhatsApp Forwards! Do NOT ❌ forward a message until you verify the content it contains.
column16: If you have any queries, reach out to your district administration or doctors!
column17: Wash your hands with soap and water often. Keep the virus at bay.
column18: The hot weather will not stop the virus! You can! Stay home, stay safe.
column19: Help the medical fraternity by staying at home!
column20: Avoid going out during the lockdown. Help break the chain of spread.
column21: Call up your loved ones during the lockdown, support each other through these times.
column22: Even the Virus Does not discriminate. Why do you? DO NOT DISCRIMINATE. WE are all Indians!
column23: Our brothers from the north east are just as Indian as you! Help everyone during this crisis❤️
column24: Get in touch with your local NGO's and District administration to volunteer for this cause.
column25: This will pass too. Enjoy your time at home and spend quality time with your family! Things will be normal soon.
column26: #BreakTheChain of Unverified WhatsApp Forwards which spread wrong information! Don't forward unless you verify it.
